defect_1_combo_broker_feasibility.observed_symptom: BROKER_FEASIBILITY combo requests failed with BROKER_FEASIBILITY_ARGUMENTS_INVALID / BROKER_FEASIBILITY_COMBO_LEG_CONTRACT_REQUIRED at stage REQUEST_VALIDATION, before any IBKR transmission.
model_retry_sequence: whatif_iova_oct16_15_18_call_spread (descriptor legs, no conId) -> correctly rejected
defect_1_combo_broker_feasibility.root_cause: The combo leg validator (_validate_flat_feasibility_args) and the BAG builder (_feasibility_contract_from_args) resolved leg contract identity ONLY from flat leg keys (conId/con_id/contract_id). The repository's canonical contract identity, emitted to the model by IBKRResearchToolbox._serialize_contract(), is a NESTED object. When the model supplied authoritative broker-resolved contracts under leg['contract'] -- the exact shape the toolbox itself produces -- the identity was invisible to validation and the request was rejected before reaching IBKR.
defect_1_combo_broker_feasibility.root_cause_class: contract-shape mismatch between the model-facing tool contract and the validator; not a missing feature
defect_1_combo_broker_feasibility.fix: Added IBKRResearchToolbox._combo_leg_contract_spec() and ._combo_leg_contract_id(), which resolve leg identity from the canonical nested contract object or the flat leg. Both the validator and the BAG builder now use them. Reuses the repository's existing canonical representation; no parallel combo representation was introduced.
defect_1_combo_broker_feasibility.additional_hardening: Ambiguous combos whose legs share one contract identity are now rejected with BROKER_FEASIBILITY_COMBO_LEG_DUPLICATE at REQUEST_VALIDATION (required case F, previously unimplemented).

defect_2_post_market_orchestration.observed_symptom: After the 2026-10-02 regular close the service kept waking on its scan cadence and running new-trade research cycles; each cycle requested a realtime quote that no longer existed and the market-data gate failed closed.

empirical_evidence.note: Alert-level deduplication already existed (_last_recovery_gate_failure_fingerprint), so only 2 RECOVERY_GATE_FAILURE alerts were emitted. The unbounded component was the CYCLE loop and its state_events, not the alert table.

defect_2_post_market_orchestration.root_cause: The service loop had no notion of a trading session. Cycle scheduling was driven purely by elapsed monotonic cadence and position presence, so a closed market produced an endless sequence of full research cycles whose only possible outcome was a correct fail-closed market-data block.
defect_2_post_market_orchestration.explicitly_not_the_defect: The market-data gate behaved correctly. No market-data validation was weakened.
defect_2_post_market_orchestration.fix: New module ibkr_paper_30d/session_orchestration.py provides a pure deterministic decision derived from the repository's existing authoritative calendar abstraction (market_observation.classify_session over IBKR contractDetails.liquidHours + timeZoneId).

decision_table.UNKNOWN_calendar: RUN_AUTONOMOUS_CYCLE (idle requires positive proof; never suppress existing gates)

defect_2_post_market_orchestration.calendar_coverage: timezone, weekends, US market holidays, early-close sessions and DST transitions are all derived from IBKR liquidHours rather than a hard-coded clock rule. No 'if hour >= 16' logic was introduced.
defect_2_post_market_orchestration.record_storm_control: MARKET_CLOSED_IDLE is appended once per transition (guarded by _last_orchestration_action), not once per poll.
defect_2_post_market_orchestration.authority_safety: The idle decision grants no authority, produces no receipt, and its event payload is asserted to contain none of gate_status / receipt_sha256 / order_authority / market_data_gate / authorized / passed.
defect_2_post_market_orchestration.backward_compatibility: session_evidence_reader defaults to None. With no calendar evidence wired the service behaves exactly as baseline e581219, proven by test_service_without_session_evidence_preserves_existing_behaviour.

unresolved_risks.risk: The canonical checkout C:/AI_VAULT_IBKR is currently on branch codex/ibkr-oct2-pending-remediation-v1 at 58ca069, while the scheduled task pins ApprovedHead=e5812193692f9599b9d0f9e8507869ba5d100840. The next scheduled run (Mon 2026-10-05 09:35 local) would therefore fail its approved-head check and BLOCK rather than trade. This is fail-closed, not fail-open, but it is an operational posture change caused by this work and requires an explicit Owner decision (promote the remediation branch and update ApprovedHead, or restore the baseline checkout).

The baseline e581219 service process (PID 48224) is still running and still executing post-close cycles (48 cycles after 20:00Z, most recent 23:56Z). The remediation is NOT deployed, so the post-market cycle storm continues until the Owner acts. This work deliberately did not stop that process.

BROKER_WHATIF_PASS was obtained while the market was closed, so IBKR returned DBL_MAX margin sentinels and zero commission. The round trip to IBKR is proven (authoritative regulatory warningText returned, 1 whatIfOrder transmitted), but margin/commission computation for a combo is NOT proven. A during-session re-validation is recommended before operational promotion.

IBKRResearchToolbox._what_if_evidence is a pass-through that reports success whenever IBKR returns any state object, including DBL_MAX 'not computed' sentinels. This is PRE-EXISTING baseline behaviour, untouched by this work, and affects flat orders identically. It was deliberately not changed because BROKER_FEASIBILITY is an observational research tool and the instruction was to keep observational diagnostics observational. Flagged for auditor judgement.

session_evidence_reader is currently unwired in production. No caller supplies liquidHours/timeZoneId yet, so the orchestration fix is inert until a launch path provides session evidence. The code is deliberately backward-compatible (None => baseline behaviour), but the defect is not actually mitigated in production until that wiring is added and audited.

The orchestration decision treats PREMARKET as a non-trading session. If the experiment is ever intended to act premarket, that policy must be revisited by the Owner; it was chosen because the market-data gate already requires MarketSession.REGULAR.

explicitly_not_proven: Combo margin and commission computation by IBKR for a BAG order (market closed at validation; DBL_MAX sentinels returned).
